name: detection_c02c
description: C02c: XR_runDetection3D_frame_parallel ('lowSNR' without the background correction, XR_runDetTrack3d's detection) on the first 4 frames of both channels of an experiment of the point-detection demo (the experiment folder from PK5D_C02C_EX: its raw and DS frames, settings file and Detection3D.mat for the PSF sigma), MATLAB against run_detection_frame_parallel at 4 threads, the results removed before each run (untimed). MATLAB starts with its JVM, as XR_runDetTrack3d's session does (the condition loader needs it).
